title: Signatures Block
description: Signature block for one or more parties, laid out in a configurable number of columns. The header and party text fields pass through inline markup.

new_page.description: Start signatures on a new page

contract_intro.description: Render the standard contract preamble ('Detta avtal har upprättats i två (2) likalydande exemplar, av vilka parterna tagit var sitt.') above the signatures. Set true for contracts; omit for documents that are not contracts.

header.description: Optional section header text shown above the signatures (e.g. 'Underskrifter'). Omit for no header. Inline markup applies: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, "quotes", and the change markers {+added text+} (green) / [-removed text-] (red strikethrough). A newline becomes a space — the field is single-line.

columns.description: Number of signature panes per row

show_location_date.description: Show the 'Ort och datum' line and dotted entry above each signature line

name.description: Party/company name (omit to suppress the bold header above the signature). Inline markup applies: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, "quotes", and the change markers {+added text+} (green) / [-removed text-] (red strikethrough). A newline becomes a space — the field is single-line.

signatory.description: Name of person signing (defaults to name if omitted). Inline markup applies: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, "quotes", and the change markers {+added text+} (green) / [-removed text-] (red strikethrough). A newline becomes a space — the field is single-line.

title.description: Signatory title, e.g. 'Verkställande Direktör, Acme AB'. Inline markup applies: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, "quotes", and the change markers {+added text+} (green) / [-removed text-] (red strikethrough). A newline becomes a space — the field is single-line.
